verdicts.reason: Both break the layout the same way. The body copy sits on top of the teal circle, cut off from the can it belongs with. GLACIER drops below the headline, so the reading order is reversed. The CTA is jammed into one row with two badges of about the same weight, so it doesn't stand out. A also crowds the can toward the left and leaves a large dead area on the right. B spreads the elements across the width with a proper right margin, but its can floats alone in the middle with wide empty gaps on either side, so it is only marginally better.
